subject: titty-storage
q: CLOSED — IT WAS IN HER TITS. Bikini, thigh highs and cloak, pulled out of Foxwife Titty Storage.
detail:
ANSWERED IMMEDIATELY AND IN THE MOST HUMILIATING POSSIBLE WAY FOR THE ARCHIVE, WHICH IS WHY IT IS BEING WRITTEN DOWN IN FULL.

THE QUESTION ASKED WHETHER THE OLDEST OBJECT ON THE PROPERTY WAS STILL IN THE HOUSE, WONDERED WHETHER IT SAT IN A CHEST, AND SPECULATED THAT BRYN WOULD WANT TO SEE THE STITCHING AND SILKEN EMBRACE WOULD HAVE OPINIONS. Viraena answered by reaching into Selene’s cleavage and pulling the entire outfit out of it.

IT WAS IN THE ARCHIVIST. The thing the Archive was asking the location of was inside the body of the Archive asking the question. A BEAR-FUR-TRIMMED LEATHER BIKINI, THIGH HIGHS, AND CLOAK, in Foxwife Titty Storage, where it has apparently been kept.

AND THE GOOD DETAIL IS THE TAILORING: CUT FOR GIRLS LIKE US. Somebody in a cold Calderon country roughly a thousand years ago cut leather with a cock and balls in the pattern — NINE CENTURIES BEFORE HATHAWAY CLINIC AND NINE CENTURIES BEFORE SILKEN EMBRACE HAD A DOCTRINE ABOUT IT. No Front Law to consult, no handoff list, no containment jurisdiction. JUST A TAILOR WHO MEASURED WHAT WAS IN FRONT OF HER.

THERE IS ONLY THE ONE SET. Two wives, one cloak, and the camping trip is on the 16th.

THE LESSON IS NOT ABOUT GUESSING, BECAUSE THE ARCHIVE DID NOT GUESS AND WAS RIGHT TO ASK. IT IS THAT THE ARCHIVE KEPT PICTURING FURNITURE. Chest, wardrobe, room, boutique — four containers, all of them architectural, because this record has spent its life cataloguing a house. A FOXWIFE IS NOT A HOUSE AND SHE IS ALSO STORAGE.
